root_idea.summary: A root associated with movement, variation, and lack of settled stability.
root_idea.development: The continually moving sun provides the central image; related developments describe sunny or clear conditions and, figuratively, beings or dispositions that resist remaining still, become refractory, or display hostility.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole QAC group is a Quran-attested lexical noun and is displayed under its normalized citation form.

senses.definition: The sun: the solar body or disk, and the light diffused from it.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun may refer to the celestial solar body or to its radiating light. Quranic occurrences use the ordinary noun across varied grammatical cases and attached particles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become sunny or sunshiny; of a day, to have sunshine, be clear or unobscured, or have vehement sun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a day or weather conditions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become sunny or acquire sunshine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV counterpart to the weather sense of شَمَسَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, to refuse to be ridden or mounted, take fright and break loose, or rebel against its rider.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The use describes forceful resistance and refusal to remain still; it is also applied to a she-camel in related derived usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a woman, to abstain from looking at men and from exciting their desire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use explicitly applied to a woman’s reserved or sexually non-encouraging conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To show enmity toward someone, making the hostility apparent or intending to act on it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported especially with لِـ; a variant construction with فِي is also recorded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of wine, to overcome and run away with its drinker.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction comparing wine’s effect to a refractory horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To worship the sun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II causative/intensive usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To spread or expose something in the sun or sunshine so that it dries.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II usage with an object being dried by exposure to sunlight.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To oppose someone and treat him with enmity or hostility.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III reciprocal or adversative usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ascend a mountain toward the sun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare lexically reported use, preserved as distinct from the weather sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sit in the sun or sunshine, or to expose oneself to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V reflexive usage describing deliberate exposure to sunlight.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be niggardly, tenacious, or avaricious toward someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَلَيْهِ in the reported construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An ancient idol called “the Sun.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical religious and proper-name usage distinct from the celestial noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of necklace or collar, its pendant or suspended ornament, a dog’s collar, or a related women’s ornament.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is treated as masculine in this ornamental sense and has the plural شُمُوسٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of comb formerly used by women for arranging their hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An archaic implement sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Solar; of or relating to the sun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions such as “solar year.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: The first annual increase in a flock of sheep or goats.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized term reported in some Arab usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The disposition of a horse that refuses to be ridden or mounted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of disposition corresponding to the refractory-horse usage of شَمَسَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman’s disposition of abstaining from looking at men and from exciting their desire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative noun of disposition explicitly applied to a woman.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse that refuses to be ridden, takes fright and runs away, or rebels against its rider; also, by extension, a she-camel with this disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural forms شُمُسٌ and شُمْسٌ are reported for the animal sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who abstains from looking at men and from exciting their desire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative personal description derived from the refractory or non-yielding sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who is refractory, untractable, perverse, stubborn, or obstinate; also one harsh or vehement in enmity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description of a difficult disposition or hard opposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wine that overcomes and runs away with its drinker.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative noun based on the behavior of a refractory horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A Christian church official who keeps to the church and traditionally shaves the middle of his head; in later usage, a deacon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is reported as non-native or not fully sound Arabic by some authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sunny or sunshiny day; a clear, cloudless, or intensely hot day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally of a day and extended to closely related forms meaning clear or sunlit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A neck bearing ornaments of the kind called شُمُوسٌ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A possessive adjective describing a neck furnished with such ornaments.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More, or most, resistant, incompliant, or obstinate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or superlative adjective of resistance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Made or spread in the sun or sunshine to dry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Passive participial usage describing something dried by solar exposure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A worshipper of the sun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Active participial usage describing a person devoted to solar worship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One sitting in, setting himself up in, or exposing himself to the sun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participle corresponding to تَشَمَّسَ in its sunlight-exposure sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who defends what is behind him or is strong in what sustains and supports him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of steadfast self-protection or support.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Extremely niggardly, tenacious, or avaricious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized personal-quality sense distinct from exposure to the sun.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Exposing something to dry in sunshine.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the first signification.
Sitting or exposing oneself in sunlight.
Celestial sun noun; grammatical remarks are ancillary.
Sun or sunshine wording is covered by the Quranic noun sense.
Passive participle for drying in sunlight.

cautions: Classical lexical evidence distinguishes the solar body or disk from the light diffused from it, while the Quranic occurrences are represented under the single noun شَمْسٌ.
